facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Hung Quoc Tu Pagoda sits on Nguyễn Trung Trực and almost nobody stops. No ticket booth. No tour bus. Just incense smoke, quiet courtyards, and locals who actually come here to pray. Phu Quoc has beaches covered. This is the side most visitors never see. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Step inside Hung Quoc Tu Pagoda while the tour groups stay on the beach. Incense rising, lanterns lit, zero crowds. This is Phu Quoc at its quietest.
